_note: Tenant = AD_Client (no Value column; keyed by Name). IMPORTANT: a raw insert creates only the AD_Client row - it does NOT perform the full 'Initial Client Setup' (which also creates the * organisation, roles, accounting schema, calendar and document sequences). Use this for a registry-style tenant record; full provisioning is a separate Onfinity process. Many NN config flags (AutoArchive, MMPolicy, IsPostImmediate, ...) are left to model defaults.

initialSetup.label: Initial Client Setup - fully provisions a new tenant (client + organisation + admin & org users + roles + accounting schema + calendar + sequences) in one transaction via MSetup.CreateClient.
initialSetup._pending: NOT YET EXECUTABLE: Initial Client Setup is a UI-wizard model method (MSetup.CreateClient), not a registered AD_Process, so VAAPI RunProcess cannot call it. Requires a thin server-side wrapper - register an AD_Process whose class calls MSetup.CreateClient(ClientName, OrgName, AdminUserName, NormalUserName), with search key 'InitialClientSetup' and these 4 parameters. Once registered, POST /v1/Tenant/actions/initialSetup activates with no further API change.
